annotations.title: Learn the faith from the house's own pages

description: PURPOSE: Read what The Living Bread wrote about the Christian faith, quoted not rewritten: the gospel in four steps, a doctrine, a parable or miracle of Jesus, a hymn and its story, a biblical name's meaning, a sourced saint, denomination, sacred site, biblical figure or Bible place, the saints of a date, two traditions side by side, a respectful page for someone from another faith or none, a page for a hard season of life, or a ready-written prayer. WHEN TO USE: "what is the gospel", "what is grace", "explain the prodigal son", "the story of Amazing Grace", "what does Elijah mean", "who was Augustine", "who is remembered on October 4", "Baptists and Methodists", "I grew up Muslim", "I just lost my dad", "a prayer before surgery". WHEN NOT: verses for a need or topic: find_scripture_for. The Bible text itself: read_scripture. A free question that fits no mode: search (mode answer). A real church or group: find_churches or find_communities. MODES (required parameters in brackets): gospel [none]. belief [subject, a doctrine such as "grace" or "the Trinity"]. parable [subject, "prodigal son"]. miracle [subject, "raising Lazarus"]. hymn [subject, a title or a line]. name_meaning [subject, one name]. saint [subject, a saint's name] the sourced record. saint_of_the_day [none] the saints remembered on date ("October 4" or YYYY-MM-DD; default today in UTC). heritage [kind, subject] one denomination, saint, sacred-site, biblical-figure or bible-place. compare_traditions [subject, compare_with] two denominations. other_faiths [subject, the person's background in their words: "Muslim", "grew up Hindu", "nothing really"]. hard_season [subject, the moment: "grief", "church hurt"]. a_prayer_for [subject, the situation]. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: the page modes (belief, parable, miracle, hymn, name_meaning, hard_season, a_prayer_for, other_faiths, saint_of_the_day) give matched (page path or null), title, url, body in the house's words, verses [{ref, text}] read verbatim from the stored KJV, related, suggestions when unmatched, hub and door; gospel gives confession, steps [{heading, words, ref, text}], who_is_jesus and doors; heritage and saint give id (an lb: URN), name, url, sameAs and provenance; compare_traditions gives a, b, shared_root and posture. BEHAVIOR: read only. Page modes fetch living-bread.org at call time; heritage, saint and compare_traditions read the Christian Knowledge API live; gospel is fixed text with its verses read from the stored KJV. Matching is by slug, then by words; a weak match sets exact false; nothing held returns matched null with suggestions, or a not_found error for heritage and saint. content_layers marks the house's words as interpretation, never Scripture. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

compare_with.description: For compare_traditions: the second denomination, e.g. "Eastern Orthodox Church".

date.description: For saint_of_the_day: "October 4", "4 Oct" or YYYY-MM-DD; the year is ignored. Omit for today (UTC).

kind.description: For heritage: which kind of entity subject names.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: gospel, belief, parable, miracle, hymn, name_meaning, saint, saint_of_the_day, heritage, compare_traditions, other_faiths, hard_season, a_prayer_for. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

subject.description: The one thing asked about, in plain words: a doctrine, parable, miracle, hymn, name, saint, denomination, background, life moment or situation. Required for every mode except gospel and saint_of_the_day.

name: learn_the_faith

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Learn the faith from the house's own pages
